evidence: GitHub REST API: self-hosted runner labels
GitHub Actions docs: using labels with self-hosted runners

decision_trace.observed: The scoped target workflow requires self-hosted/linux/x64/andreas/claycode/target. Existing .runner state bypasses fresh config.sh, so an older registered runner can remain unable to match the scoped job. A concurrent worker independently improved token reuse and desktop service-environment propagation while this repair was being prepared.
alternatives: relax workflow back to generic self-hosted/linux/x64 labels
destroy and re-register every existing runner
add missing scoped custom labels to the exact verified existing runner
decision_trace.selected: add missing scoped custom labels to the exact verified existing runner
decision_trace.reason: Preserves the scoped workflow, avoids destructive re-registration, preserves unrelated labels, and keeps all physical-target and release gates fail-closed.
decision_trace.falsifier: A fresh Andreas-target execution receipt showing the patch cannot bring the exact local runner online with the required label set, or GitHub rejects the repository runner-label mutation under the authenticated target account.
